OccupancyNo single event, or any simultaneously held combination of events, shall be attended by more than 14,999 occupants, including visitors and staff up until 23rd November 2026.  After which, no single event, or any simultaneously held combination of events, shall be attended by more than 10,000 occupants, including visitors and staff at any one time.Reason: To ensure there are no undue impacts on the transport and road network and protect neighbouring amenity
Bicycle ProvisionThe bicycle parking shall be provided in accordance with drawing (BWD063-PL-200/E).	Reason: To comply with Policy T5 of the London Plan.

Noise MonitoringPrior to the first live music event after 23rd November 2026, details of the additional noise monitoring locations shall be submitted to and agreed in writing with the Local Planning Authority.  The live music events shall be monitored at these locations in accordance with the Noise Management Plan.Reason: To ensure that the noise levels are managed effectively in accordance with the Noise Management Plan and limit the impact on adjoining residents

Loading BayThe loading bay shall not operate before 07:00 or after 22:30 from 23rd November until 20th December 2026.Reason: To ensure that the operation of the loading bay does not result in undue levels of noise and disturbance to adjoining residents

Green Zone RestrictionThe area demarked as "Green Zone" on plan AW26 2.4 U._Drumsheds_25-03869-VAR_Site Plan_240326 shall not be used for operational purposes from 23rd November until 20th December 2026.Reason: To ensure that adjoining residents are protected from outdoor noise and disturbance.

Time LimitThis permission is for a limited period, expiring on 20th December, after which time the use hereby permitted shall be discontinued.  The structures installed and works carried out under this permission shall be removed and the land returned to its previous state.Reason: To comply with the provisions of S.51 of the Planning & Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

UseThe development hereby approved shall be used as a creative and cultural venue only for the following functions:o	Filming and TV studio useo	Performance and rehearsal space for theatre and the artso	Corporate and brand eventso	Exhibitions for arts and cultural/ creative useso	Food and Drink eventso	Community eventso	Live music eventsNo live music events are to take place on any days apart from Saturdays and Sundays after 23rd November 2026.The development is not to be used for any other purpose, including within any Class of the of the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 as amended September 2020 (or any equivalent class in any order that may replace it), or any use for which no class is specified in Paragraph 3 (6) of the Use Classes Order and which is not listed above.Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and because highway and other impacts have been assessed onthe basis of the above quantum of development in accordance with policies D2 and D3 of the NewLondon Plan (2021) and CP1 and CP2 of Enfield's Core Strategy (2010).

Hours of UseAny events held indoors shall not operate outside the hours of 08:00am and 03:00am until 23rd November 2026, after which time any events held indoors shall not operate outside the hours of 08:00 and 22:30 on Saturdays and 08:00 and 22:00 on Sundays.  No live music events are to take place on Fridays after 23rd November 2026.Reason: To ensure no undue impacts on transport and road network and neighbouring amenity.

description: Variation of condition 01 of Ref: 23/02199/FUL to allow an extension of the temporary use for multi-purpose use (Sui Generis) as a cultural and creative events and entertainment space until 20th December 2026 with a reduced operational framework from the period 23rd November to 20th December including a reduced capacity from 15,000 to 10,000, streamlined events schedule restricted to Saturdays and Sundays with curfews of 22:30 and 22:00 respectively, reconfiguration of external operational areas and reduced hours of operation of the loading bay from 07:00-22:30 for this period only.
